title: Preterm Infant Multicentre Growth Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to improve health professionals understanding of preterm infant growth patterns, and to determine if early growth patterns predict risks of adverse metabolic and cognitive outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \< 32 weeks gestational age at birth

Exclusion Criteria:

* infants who had congenital anomalies or those who died prior to discharge
